name: Recomputed schedule
description: The oracle on 914 qubits. As in the 1,072-qubit entry, each intermediate hash is measured away and its phase removed later. The header's second block, which set that count, no longer holds 16 schedule words: only two of its message words are quantum, so it holds seven words in progress and computes the older ones again from those two when a step needs them, in two spare registers. Its uncomputation subtracts and measures away the kept state first, which leaves room for an ordinary schedule. Four times the baseline's Toffolis.
